stages.title: SUBORDINATE ENRICHMENT — ONLY AFTER THE COMPLETE CORE

pills.text: R&D SUCCESS IS A NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT CONDITION
TESTING MUST CONVERT INTO REPEATABLE PRODUCTION QUALITY, LIFECYCLE MAINTENANCE
PUBLICLY AVAILABLE OPEN-SOURCE DATA ON MISSILE RANGE AND PAYLOAD
UPSC-FRIENDLY WRITING SHOULD PREFER OFFICIAL QUALITATIVE LABELS OVER SENSATIONAL
A MISSILE CLUSTER IS NOT MERELY ABOUT END PRODUCTS
IT IS ALSO ABOUT MASTERING PROPULSION, SENSORS, MATERIALS, GUIDANCE
THE SAME ECOSYSTEM CAN GENERATE SPILLOVERS FOR AEROSPACE MATERIALS

groups.heading: OPTIONAL SCIENTIFIC / ENGINEERING DEPTH
items: CAUTION: R&D success is a necessary but not sufficient condition for strategic autonomy
testing must convert into repeatable production quality, lifecycle maintenance and doctrinal integration.
CAUTION: Publicly available open-source data on missile range and payload is often noisy
UPSC-friendly writing should prefer official qualitative labels over sensational figures.

groups.heading: READINESS, UNIT OR STATUS LIMIT
items: CAUTION: A missile cluster is not merely about end products
it is also about mastering propulsion, sensors, materials, guidance and test infrastructure.
CAUTION: The same ecosystem can generate spillovers for aerospace materials, electronics, navigation and high-end manufacturing.
DRDO: official site calls it the R&D wing of the Ministry of Defence and states its mission of self-reliance in critical defence technologies

groups.heading: COMPARATIVE TECHNOLOGY / GOVERNANCE NUANCE
items: its function is to design/develop and to facilitate production and induction.
Department of Defence R&D: administrative umbrella for DRDO.
Department of Defence Production (DDP): the distinct MoD department for production infrastructure, DPSUs and manufacturing indigenisation.
The R&D-production split is the institutional fact most often missed in answers.
